# Icon Replacer v1.0.0-rc.1

This first public release candidate provides the Gallery First app and packaged Windows Explorer integration as downloadable x64 MSIX artifacts.

## Highlights

- Change and restore folder and `.lnk` shortcut icons.
- Browse, import, search, and reuse icons from `%USERPROFILE%\.icons`.
- Use Icon Replacer from both the Windows 11 modern menu and **Show more options**.
- Open native picker and icon-collection commands without launching the management window.
- Use one canonical Icon Replacer identity across the app, package, and Explorer.

## Downloads

- `IconReplacer_1.0.0.6_x64.msix` — application package.
- `IconReplacer.Dev.cer` — public development certificate required to trust this candidate.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` — integrity hashes for every public release asset.
- `release-metadata.json` — package version, signer, thumbprint, hash, and source revision.

Follow the [download, verification, installation, and uninstall guide](https://github.com/gvastethecreator/icon-replacer/blob/v1.0.0-rc.1/docs/operations/RELEASE.md).

## Candidate warning

This is a prerelease signed by `CN=IconReplacerDev`, not a production-trusted stable build. Windows requires an explicit certificate trust step. Verify the published hashes and certificate thumbprint before installing.

Certificate thumbprint: `F235B1142A11E383C0673599772334C0F0797F4A`  
MSIX SHA-256: `5D22F3D823924B876A7B5C687595FAB4F4813783CDE51E03C1FF48E621563563`
